Indian Startup's Satellite Battery Successfully Tested in Space

Hyderabad-based startup TakeMe2Space announced its indigenous satellite battery, PowerBank-50, has been successfully tested in space. The battery powered a payload on Skyroot Aerospace's Vikram-1 mission. This marks the first time an India-made satellite battery has been proven in space, according to reports.
